title: ECG Ensemble External Evaluation: Reproducible Scores and Analyses of Two Pipelines
description: Software, public-record-ID probability exports, fitted classification heads and fixed statistical analyses accompanying an external validation study of two ECG pipelines. Includes five-seed same/mixed-family controls, input matching, population and ontology sensitivities, calibration and threshold diagnostics, and a descriptive historically viewed PTB-XL reference. One external hospital and one frozen encoder; no untouched confirmation or clinical-device claim. Raw waveforms, patient-group identifiers and demographics are excluded. Own code/heads MIT; derived scores/own numerical exports CC0; bundled protocol CC-BY-4.0. See per-component notices.
notes: Version DOI reserved before sealing:10.5281/zenodo.23729209. Public distribution repository:https://github.com/Dan7651/ecg-ensemble-external-evaluation. Component licenses are specified in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
